title: Spectrum
empty: No exposure of {{detectors}} could measure this point.
chart: Flux against wavelength, one point per exposure
hint: The line shows how bright the object is at each wavelength: higher means brighter. Point at a dot to see that measurement.
allDoubtful: Almost every measurement here is doubtful (very bright or crowded target), so the dashed line is only a rough guide.
intro: Pick the detectors you want to see. Each one is measured the first time you turn it on (10 to 50 seconds) and joins the chart in its own colour. Press it again to hide it.
errorBar: Margin of error (shown when you point at a dot)
failed: Could not measure {{detectors}}. Press it again to retry.
measuring: Measuring {{detectors}}… Press a detector being measured to stop it.

method.label: Method
method.apertureHelp: Adds up the light inside a 3-pixel circle. Simple, and good for bright isolated stars.
method.psfHelp: Fits the known shape of a star at the exact point. Less noisy on faint objects and not thrown off by a bad pixel.
